## Meet Our Brands

What began with Edible Arrangements® in 1999 has evolved into a family of innovative brands under
the Edible Brands® umbrella. Today, we power a dynamic ecosystem of brands—each dedicated to helping
people savor life in every form.
Founded in 1999, Edible Arrangements® has revolutionized the gifting industry. From dessert boards
and delicious baked treats to fresh-cut flowers and chocolate-dipped fruit platters, today's Edible®
offers much more than the iconic fruit bouquet that started it all.

### Edible.com®

Edible’s model combines a centralized ecommerce engine with a distributed franchise network. Over
80% of orders originate on Edible.com and are fulfilled by locally owned and operated stores across
the U.S. and Canada. This asset-light hybrid delivers national demand capture with local last-mile
execution, driving operating leverage for the brand and two revenue streams for franchisees.
#1 Most Preferred Food Gifting Brand¹
82% Brand Awareness
$242B Size of the Gifting Industry
$1.1T Size of B2B Gifting by 2028
99% Orders Delivered by Franchise Systems

### Our Story

Edible Arrangements® was founded in 1999 by entrepreneur and visionary Tariq Farid, who opened the
first Edible® store in East Haven, CT. The unique venture quickly evolved into a flourishing
franchise empire. The company remains family owned and operated, with Somia Farid Silber at the helm
as CEO since 2024.

1999 to 2008: From Shop to System
* The first Edible Arrangements® store opens in East Haven, CT under the ownership of brand founder,
  Tariq Farid.
* Franchising begins; the first Edible Arrangements® franchise opens in Waltham, MA.
* Edible Arrangements® acquired and rebranded a supply-chain entity, now BerryDirect, which serves
  as the system-wide engine for sourcing, packaging, and fulfillment and enables scale into larger
  delivery networks.
* Edible Arrangements® made its first national TV debut on ESPN targeting men for Valentine’s.
* Edible Arrangements® launched an ahead-of-its-time website for online ordering via
  ediblearrangements.com, accepting internet orders for the first time and opening a new digital
  revenue channel.
* Founder Tariq Farid's goal to open 50 stores by 2005 was wildly surpassed when he opened the
  brand's 500th store powered by disciplined execution, engaged franchisees, and a repeatable
  playbook.
* Edible Arrangements® unveiled its gifting industry disruptive WOW Guarantee (now known as the
  Edible Guarantee), a 100% happiness promise: if an order is not perfect, we replace it or refund
  it.
2009 to 2018: Growth & Diversification
* Edible Arrangements® launched the first generation of the mobile app, another milestone in the
  brand’s convenience focus for customers.
* Edible Arrangements® announced the relocation of corporate HQ from Connecticut to Atlanta,
  Georgia.
* Edible Arrangements® scaled delivery capabilities, through BerryDirect, unlocking nationwide
  gifting for long distance customers and stronger connections.
* Edible Arrangements® opened its 1,000th store which was a defining moment in franchise expansion.

# ALPLA is a world leader in the development and production of innovative plastic packaging
# solutions.

We produce innovative packaging systems, bottles, caps and injection-moulded parts for a wide range
of industries since 1955. Our long history as a family-run business, our cutting-edge technologies
and the knowledge and dedication of our employees set us and our products apart. Our business
activities are founded on sustainability and the climate-friendly use of resources. With our more
than 30 years of experience in recycling and our own recycling plants, we play our part in ensuring
that plastics remain in the materials cycle.

# ALPLA is a world leader in the development and production of innovative plastic packaging
# solutions.

We produce innovative packaging systems, bottles, caps and injection-moulded parts for a wide range
of industries since 1955. Our long history as a family-run business, our cutting-edge technologies
and the knowledge and dedication of our employees set us and our products apart. Our business
activities are founded on sustainability and the climate-friendly use of resources. With our more
than 30 years of experience in recycling and our own recycling plants, we play our part in ensuring
that plastics remain in the materials cycle.

As a premier packaging manufacturer, we supply high-barrier mylar bags, heavy-duty stand up pouches,
and customizable three-side seal flat bags engineered to preserve product freshness and elevate your
brand’s retail presence.

## ****WHO WE ARE****

Kazuo Beiyin Paper and Plastic Packaging Co., Ltd. is a well-known manufacturer of ***[custom
packaging bags][77]***, established in 1998, and is committed to the development and production of
customized packaging products, including high-temperature sterilization bags. Vacuum bags, aluminum
foil bags, kraft paper bags, stand-up bags, flat bags,side gusset bags,flat bottom bags,fin seal
bags,roll film, spout bags, die-cut bags, mylar bags, white card boxes, corrugated boxes, hardcover
gift boxes, etc. The products sell well in the United States, Europe, Southeast Asia, Africa, and
other parts of the world, and they have agents in the United States.

[View details][78]

In early 2014, Beyin Packing, following the trend of the times and focusing on the international
market, established the International Trade Department. In order to develop the market, Beyin
Packing participated in the Canton Fair, American Packaging Exhibition, Italian Food Exhibition,
South Africa Exhibition, and Hong Kong Resources Expo to absorb foreign products and extend
international business. Nowadays, our various packaging bags, such as [***custom resealable
pouches***][79], [***snacks packing pouches***][80], etc., are exported to Europe, America, Japan,
South Korea, Southeast Asia, Africa and other places, and have won unanimous praise from
international friends.

# Sustainable Manufacturing: Our Eco- Friendly Commitment

#### Go Green

#### Go Bio-Green

We are deeply committed to pioneering the next generation of compostable plastic products,
empowering both manufacturers and consumers with the high-performance materials they depend on. As a
leading biodegradable packaging manufacturer, we believe that the plastics the world needs should
not come at the cost of the planet. Our products are engineered using advanced, environmentally
friendly biopolymers that are designed to safely return to the earth, nourishing the soil rather
than polluting it.

Whether it involves a conventional backyard compost pile managing small amounts of waste from
gardens and kitchens, or large-scale industrial composting facilities designed to process massive
volumes of municipal and commercial organic matter, our solutions are built to perform. As a premier
eco-friendly packaging manufacturer, we ensure our materials meet the most stringent compostability
standards, providing a seamless transition from use to disposal.

In the rapidly evolving landscape of sustainable packaging solutions India, we stand out by offering
versatility and reliability. Our mission is to support the diverse needs of the modern supply
chain—from retail and e-commerce to heavy industry—with robust, compostable packaging that minimizes
the carbon footprint of every shipment. By choosing our specialized plastic solutions, businesses
can confidently meet their sustainability goals while providing consumers with the guilt-free,
high-quality packaging they increasingly demand.

## Our Company Overview

Founded in 2021 in Kolkata, BioGreen Projects Pvt. Ltd. is a CIPET-certified and CPCB-recognized
leader in the manufacturing of compostable bioplastics. With a mission to build a cleaner,
sustainable future, we develop eco-friendly packaging solutions made from natural, plant-based
materials such as corn starch, and seeds, designed to safely decompose in both backyard and
industrial composting environments.

Our strong technical expertise, combined with two state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities, allows
us to serve a wide range of industrial and commercial sectors, helping clients achieve EPR and ESG
compliance. BioGreen is proudly incubated and funded by IIT Kharagpur, IIT Jammu, and IIT Mandi,
reflecting the trust and confidence of leading academic institutions in our vision and innovation.

volumes of municipal and commercial organic matter, our solutions are built to perform. As a premier
eco-friendly packaging manufacturer, we ensure our materials meet the most stringent compostability
standards, providing a seamless transition from use to disposal.

In the rapidly evolving landscape of sustainable packaging solutions India, we stand out by offering
versatility and reliability. Our mission is to support the diverse needs of the modern supply
chain—from retail and e-commerce to heavy industry—with robust, compostable packaging that minimizes
the carbon footprint of every shipment. By choosing our specialized plastic solutions, businesses
can confidently meet their sustainability goals while providing consumers with the guilt-free,
high-quality packaging they increasingly demand.

## Our Company Overview

Founded in 2021 in Kolkata, BioGreen Projects Pvt. Ltd. is a CIPET-certified and CPCB-recognized
leader in the manufacturing of compostable bioplastics. With a mission to build a cleaner,
sustainable future, we develop eco-friendly packaging solutions made from natural, plant-based
materials such as corn starch, and seeds, designed to safely decompose in both backyard and
industrial composting environments.

Our strong technical expertise, combined with two state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities, allows
us to serve a wide range of industrial and commercial sectors, helping clients achieve EPR and ESG
compliance. BioGreen is proudly incubated and funded by IIT Kharagpur, IIT Jammu, and IIT Mandi,
reflecting the trust and confidence of leading academic institutions in our vision and innovation.
Trusted by over 85 brands across healthcare, retail, F&B, and more, we provide end-to-end
sustainable solutions, from production to last-mile delivery. Our commitment to quality, innovation,
and customer satisfaction ensures that every choice made with BioGreen contributes to a greener,
healthier planet.

## Meet Our Brands

What began with Edible Arrangements® in 1999 has evolved into a family of innovative brands under
the Edible Brands® umbrella. Today, we power a dynamic ecosystem of brands—each dedicated to helping
people savor life in every form.
Founded in 1999, Edible Arrangements® has revolutionized the gifting industry. From dessert boards
and delicious baked treats to fresh-cut flowers and chocolate-dipped fruit platters, today's Edible®
offers much more than the iconic fruit bouquet that started it all.

### Edible.com®

Edible’s model combines a centralized ecommerce engine with a distributed franchise network. Over
80% of orders originate on Edible.com and are fulfilled by locally owned and operated stores across
the U.S. and Canada. This asset-light hybrid delivers national demand capture with local last-mile
execution, driving operating leverage for the brand and two revenue streams for franchisees.

### Our Story

Edible Arrangements® was founded in 1999 by entrepreneur and visionary Tariq Farid, who opened the
first Edible® store in East Haven, CT. The unique venture quickly evolved into a flourishing
franchise empire. The company remains family owned and operated, with Somia Farid Silber at the helm
as CEO since 2024.

# East Africa's first *B100 biodiesel* refinery

Giloil converts used cooking oil into distilled, ISCC-certified B100 biodiesel — powering fleets,
industry and export across the region. Backed by three decades of oils and fats manufacturing:
edible oil refining, soap production and toll processing under one roof.

What we manufacture

## One plant. Four businesses.

From waste-oil recovery to finished consumer products, Giloil runs an integrated oils and fats
operation in Nairobi's Industrial Area — flexible enough to process your feedstock, or supply you
finished product at scale.

Flagship · Division 01

### Biodiesel Manufacturing

The first and only commercial distilled B100 biodiesel plant in East, Central and Southern Africa.
Our bio-refinery converts 100% of incoming used cooking oil into fuel-grade biodiesel and marketable
by-products — built for flexibility, scaling as feedstock supply grows. Supplied in bulk for
transport fleets, industrial boilers, generators and export.

[Enquire about bulk supply →][11]

Commercial B100 plant in E. Africa

Division 02

### Edible Oil Refining

One of the few refineries in the region properly equipped to refine both palm and soft oils, with an
in-house degumming facility. High-quality edible oils and cooking fats, refined to food-grade
standards at an affordable price.

[Discuss refining capacity →][12] Division 03

### Soap Manufacturing

Laundry and multipurpose soap produced on-site from our own refined oils and fats — closing the loop
between refining by-products and finished consumer goods, with consistent quality batch after batch.

[Request product list →][13] Division 04

### Toll Processing

Contract manufacturing on your terms. Bring your feedstock or your formulation — we refine, process
and pack under your brand using our plant, our chemists and our quality systems. You keep the
margin; we handle production.

[Get a toll processing quote →][14]
Used cooking oil collection

## Your waste oil has value. We collect it.

Giloil is a NEMA-approved used cooking oil collector and recycler. Hotels, restaurants and food
processors across Kenya get a compliant, documented disposal channel — and their waste comes back to
the road as clean fuel.
1. #### Scheduled or on-call collection
   
   Regular pre-arranged pickups, or collection within 24 hours of your request — with clean
   replacement jerricans left behind.
2. #### NEMA tracking document issued
   
   Every collection comes with official documentation, keeping your business fully compliant with
   Kenyan environmental law.
3. #### Converted at our bio-refinery
   
   Every drop is processed into distilled B100 biodiesel and useful by-products — nothing goes to
   waste or into the drains.
4. #### Collected by trucks running on your oil
   
   Our entire collection fleet runs on biodiesel made from the very oil it collects. The loop is
   real, and it's on the road.

[Book a Collection][15]
Why B100

## A better molecule for your engine — and the air

Biodiesel isn't just cleaner on paper. It's safer to store, kinder to engines, and dramatically
lighter on emissions than petroleum diesel.

150°C
Flash point — non-flammable and non-explosive in storage, vs 64 °C for petro-diesel.
−80%
Reduction in carbon emissions — the CO₂ released was already in the atmosphere.
>10%
Oxygen in the biodiesel molecule — cleaner combustion, visibly less soot.
0.001%
Maximum sulphur content, with superior lubricity that reduces engine wear.

**International Journal of Current Microbiology and Applied Sciences** ISSN:2319-7692(Print),
ISSN:2319-7706(Online) is a multidisciplinary peer-reviewed journal with reputable academics and
experts as members of its Editorial Board. The Current Microbiology aims to publish all the latest

of microbiology and applied research with publishes high quality of review and research articles on
novel aspects of Microbiology including Environmental, Food, Agricultural, Medical, Pharmaceutical,
Veterinary, Soil, Water and Biodeterioration.

resistant packaging, squeeze tubes, pre-roll packaging, child resistant glass and plastic bottles,

manner with responsive customer service. We will continue to work around the clock (24/7) to offer
our customers a trustworthy "factory-direct" relationship, which will assure you that we, as your
cannabis packaging partner, are reliable and offer you a competitive price.

# Convenience doesn't have
# to cost the world

This simple food container is carefully engineered to eliminate waste and make the planet a
healthier place. Where conventional containers have petrol-based coatings that stick around forever,
this one has a 100% natural seaweed coating. Once finished, the whole package can be composted and
disappears without a trace—just like a fruit peel.
[more about Notpla Food Containers][14]

# Seaweed forever

There are forests below the sea that are very dear to us. Seaweed grows quickly, and needs no
freshwater, land or fertiliser. It captures carbon and makes the surrounding waters less acidic.

Beyond this, seaweed is abundantly available and has near-magical material properties. In the quest
to heal our ecosystems and food chains from the toxic waste of plastic packaging, it is the perfect
companion species and an integral partner to our solutions.
[more about Notpla's Impact Theory][15]

# The liquid packaging revolution

This is where it all began for Notpla.

Taking inspiration from nature, this innovative solution offers a sustainable alternative to
single-use plastic packaging. Its unique design allows the liquid to be encapsulated in a thin,
flexible layer that is 100% naturally biodegradable and entirely edible.
[more about Ooho][16]

# **Reinventing the coffee cup without plastic**

As part of a €4 million, three year Horizon Europe research project, Notpla is working to reinvent
one of the world’s most overlooked single use products.

Building on early pilots, including our Gen 1 espresso cup, the project brings together partners
across Europe and Africa to develop a high performance coffee cup with a fully natural coating that
does not rely on plastic.
[more about the Horizon Grant][17]

# Microplastics in food packaging: the hidden problem

Microplastics are now being detected across food systems, from water and seafood to human tissue.As
research evolves, attention is turning to how everyday materials, including packaging, may
contribute to exposure.
[read more][18]

# Applications for a new everyday

Our collection includes true solutions for packaging foods, drinks, care products, and many other
items you use every day. While some are edible, some compostable, and some dissolve in water — they
all disappear back into nature without any harmful traces.

## Delivering on ***Our Word***

Walking the Walk For Over 50 Years

Founded in Atlanta, Georgia by Frank Pritchard in 1972 as a manufacturer of protective packaging
products, Pak-Lite, Inc. has embarked on a progressive path of product diversification and enhanced
capabilities. Guiding them to the position of a leading North American converter/manufacturer of
US-sourced foams, rubber, nonwovens, foils, films, and specialty materials. Our customer base
includes many of the top OEM and industrial companies in the world.

[Connect with Us][20]

## **Why choose** Pak-Lite, Inc? 
## Because We **Manufacture Success**

PLI has manufacturing facilities in GA, NC, and Taiwan. We have over 300+ dedicated professionals
committed to making your project a success before, during, and after the design and manufacturing of
your product. We will help you select the best, sustainable materials for your specific application.
Join our customer base, which already includes many of the top OEM and industrial companies in the
world.

[Why We're Different][21]

## Certified to Meet **Your Manufacturing Needs**

[See Our Certifications][22]

## ***Global**
## Manufacturing Capabilities*

Our manufacturing capabilities include extrusion lamination to foams and rubber substrates. We
combine materials to composite form and then supply you with die-cut parts, components, roll stock,
or sheeting. Finished parts often include pressure-sensitive adhesives and release liners.
Additional capabilities include material selection, prototyping, skiving/slitting, rotary/flatbed
die cutting, kiss cutting, spooling, precision parts manufacturing, assembly, and much more.

[Lab][23]

## Material ***Fabrication***

We are ISO 9001:2015 and IATF 16949 certified with a wide selection of capabilities in converting
foams, rubbers, and nonwoven fabrics for the OEMs and Tier 1 automotive industry. PLI will assist
you in designing the exact components to meet your demanding specifications. We have extensive
experience with 3M Adhesives and Avery Adhesives as well as years of sourcing the top foam, rubber,
polymer, packaging, nonwoven, and fiber and film suppliers worldwide.

## How can we help you?

How we can help you with Frequently Asked Questions.

##### What’s the Packaging design process?

At the Premier Custom Boxes, we collaborate with our clients. We treat them as partners and ensure
they receive a premier experience. Our design team crafts boxes that fulfill their business goals as
per their requirements. We carry out branding, customization, printing, and share templates with
them to get their feedback.

##### Do I need to pay any shipping costs for packaging boxes?

No. You won’t have to pay any delivery charges if you place an order in any state of the USA. Our
services cover the whole of the USA. We ship custom packaging boxes perfectly, so our clients pack
products and market them correctly.

##### Is there any minimum count of packaging boxes that I can order?

You can order a minimum of 100 packaging boxes from us. This facility also comes with the offset
printing option. Our team ensures smooth and frictionless delivery no matter the packaging
shipment’s size.

##### Can I order eco-friendly packaging boxes?

You can order environment-friendly packaging boxes from us. Businesses will have the facility to opt
for kraft cardstock because of its recyclable nature. These are bio-degradable and don’t harm our
natural habitat. We use sustainable raw materials in the production process that are pure and don’t
impact our surroundings.

##### What is your order processing time?

When you order packaging boxes or printing services, the team gets down to business. The turnaround
time is fast, and our team works tirelessly on the order’s processing. Within 10 to 12 working days,
we ship boxes to your doorstep. In some cases, businesses request instant delivery. So, we also have
a rapid delivery process through which we ship orders within a week.

##### Can I get a price quote for packaging boxes?

You can visit our website and go to the price quote section. You need to fill out a form and tell us
about your requirements. You need to select the packaging box type, cardstock, and quantity of boxes
required. There’s also a section where you will mention the box dimensions, and you can also give
special instructions. Our team will respond with a detailed price quote.

##### Do I have the option of Add-ons along with the packaging boxes?

There are numerous Add-on options, and you can get complete guidance from our packaging team. These
include custom inserts that come in various forms and colors. You can use them inside the packaging
to add grace and give extra cushion to items. Similarly, boxes with magnetic lids are available. You
can style them through finishing options like Spot UV, Glossy and Matte coating.

Sci-Bot - answering questions based on research

Hear the good news: recent advances in artificial intelligence enabled Sci-Hub to launch a
[robot][2] that gives scientifically-grounded responses to questions. The robot starts with
searching for relevant literature in Sci-Hub database, then turns to selecting and reading most
recent studies, and composes the answer based on this information. The answer includes all the
references, and each referenced article can be read on Sci-Hub with one click.

Unlike question-answering robots that were based upon the early generation of neural networks,
Sci-Hub bot does not hallucinate and is not making up scientific facts and does not cite sources
that do not exist. To support its statements, Sci-Bot uses articles from Sci-Hub database. Questions
can be asked in any language, and answers can be saved on server and shared.

The alpha version only supports answerig one question, and a more advanced variation that supports
conversation mode is coming soon. Right column displays example questions that has been answered by
robot - push the question to see the generated answer.

[What is the current size of the Universe?][3]→
[To be or not to be?][4]→
[What is the most precise value for Pi number calculated to date?][5]→

# Where do I get new articles?

Sci-Hub coverage is larger than 90% for all papers published up to 2022 in major academic outlets.
Newer articles can be requested on a new platform [Sci-Net][6] which is a mutual-help social network
for researchers: you can post a request and it will be solved by other members. The fulltext
typically gets uploaded in a few minutes, except for some exotic cases. Once uploaded, the paper
remains free for everyone without registration. You can also upload your papers to ensure they will
be openly accessible forever.

The project uses Sci-Hub knowledge tokens to reward active members for helping build its open access
repository.

# database

Sci-Hub has the largest (> 88 million documents) database of full-text scientific papers, available
for free. Approximately 80% of the collection are articles from scientific journals, most of them
dedicated to the subject of medicine. That is followed by physics, chemistry and biology,
humanities, and etc. The entire collection is available for download on the [torrent network][7],
and takes up about 100 terabytes of space.

About Us
Nowadays in this fast moving world, people have less time to cook and enjoy the taste of home-cooked
food and hence in order to preserve the taste, freshness, aroma, nutrient value & warmth of food
items for longer duration of time, many types of wrapping and packing materials are used.
Incorporated in 1972, Sun Pack Corporation is a leading manufacturer, exporter, supplier, importer
and trader of an extensive range of Packing, Wrapping, Packaging and Laminated Materials such as
Printed Wax Wrappers, Plain & Printed Laminated Films in Rolls and Pouches etc. We cater to the
packing and wrapping needs of clients in domestic as well as major international markets. Our
product specialization includes Wax Coating, 8 Colour Roto Gravure Printing, Solvent Free
Lamination, etc.

[ALPLA - Family of pionieers]

# ALPLA is a world leader in the development and production of innovative plastic packaging
# solutions.

We produce innovative packaging systems, bottles, caps and injection-moulded parts for a wide range
of industries since 1955. Our long history as a family-run business, our cutting-edge technologies
and the knowledge and dedication of our employees set us and our products apart. Our business
activities are founded on sustainability and the climate-friendly use of resources. With our more
than 30 years of experience in recycling and our own recycling plants, we play our part in ensuring
that plastics remain in the materials cycle.

[Any questions? Reach out to us.][33]

# Sustainable Manufacturing: Our Eco- Friendly Commitment

#### Go Green

#### Go Bio-Green

We are deeply committed to pioneering the next generation of compostable plastic products,
empowering both manufacturers and consumers with the high-performance materials they depend on. As a
leading biodegradable packaging manufacturer, we believe that the plastics the world needs should
not come at the cost of the planet. Our products are engineered using advanced, environmentally
friendly biopolymers that are designed to safely return to the earth, nourishing the soil rather
than polluting it.

Whether it involves a conventional backyard compost pile managing small amounts of waste from
gardens and kitchens, or large-scale industrial composting facilities designed to process massive
volumes of municipal and commercial organic matter, our solutions are built to perform. As a premier
eco-friendly packaging manufacturer, we ensure our materials meet the most stringent compostability
standards, providing a seamless transition from use to disposal.

In the rapidly evolving landscape of sustainable packaging solutions India, we stand out by offering
versatility and reliability. Our mission is to support the diverse needs of the modern supply
chain—from retail and e-commerce to heavy industry—with robust, compostable packaging that minimizes
the carbon footprint of every shipment. By choosing our specialized plastic solutions, businesses
can confidently meet their sustainability goals while providing consumers with the guilt-free,
high-quality packaging they increasingly demand.

# Sustainable Manufacturing: Our Eco- Friendly Commitment

#### Go Green

#### Go Bio-Green

We are deeply committed to pioneering the next generation of compostable plastic products,
empowering both manufacturers and consumers with the high-performance materials they depend on. As a
leading biodegradable packaging manufacturer, we believe that the plastics the world needs should
not come at the cost of the planet. Our products are engineered using advanced, environmentally
friendly biopolymers that are designed to safely return to the earth, nourishing the soil rather
than polluting it.

Whether it involves a conventional backyard compost pile managing small amounts of waste from
gardens and kitchens, or large-scale industrial composting facilities designed to process massive
volumes of municipal and commercial organic matter, our solutions are built to perform. As a premier
eco-friendly packaging manufacturer, we ensure our materials meet the most stringent compostability
standards, providing a seamless transition from use to disposal.

In the rapidly evolving landscape of sustainable packaging solutions India, we stand out by offering
versatility and reliability. Our mission is to support the diverse needs of the modern supply
chain—from retail and e-commerce to heavy industry—with robust, compostable packaging that minimizes
the carbon footprint of every shipment. By choosing our specialized plastic solutions, businesses
can confidently meet their sustainability goals while providing consumers with the guilt-free,
high-quality packaging they increasingly demand.

# East Africa's first *B100 biodiesel* refinery

Giloil converts used cooking oil into distilled, ISCC-certified B100 biodiesel — powering fleets,
industry and export across the region. Backed by three decades of oils and fats manufacturing:
edible oil refining, soap production and toll processing under one roof.

What we manufacture

## One plant. Four businesses.

From waste-oil recovery to finished consumer products, Giloil runs an integrated oils and fats
operation in Nairobi's Industrial Area — flexible enough to process your feedstock, or supply you
finished product at scale.

Flagship · Division 01

### Biodiesel Manufacturing

The first and only commercial distilled B100 biodiesel plant in East, Central and Southern Africa.
Our bio-refinery converts 100% of incoming used cooking oil into fuel-grade biodiesel and marketable
by-products — built for flexibility, scaling as feedstock supply grows. Supplied in bulk for
transport fleets, industrial boilers, generators and export.

Division 02

### Edible Oil Refining

One of the few refineries in the region properly equipped to refine both palm and soft oils, with an
in-house degumming facility. High-quality edible oils and cooking fats, refined to food-grade
standards at an affordable price.

[Discuss refining capacity →][12] Division 03

### Soap Manufacturing

Laundry and multipurpose soap produced on-site from our own refined oils and fats — closing the loop
between refining by-products and finished consumer goods, with consistent quality batch after batch.

[Request product list →][13] Division 04

### Toll Processing

Contract manufacturing on your terms. Bring your feedstock or your formulation — we refine, process
and pack under your brand using our plant, our chemists and our quality systems. You keep the
margin; we handle production.

[Get a toll processing quote →][14]
Used cooking oil collection

## Your waste oil has value. We collect it.

Giloil is a NEMA-approved used cooking oil collector and recycler. Hotels, restaurants and food
processors across Kenya get a compliant, documented disposal channel — and their waste comes back to
the road as clean fuel.
1. #### Scheduled or on-call collection
   
   Regular pre-arranged pickups, or collection within 24 hours of your request — with clean
   replacement jerricans left behind.
2. #### NEMA tracking document issued
   
   Every collection comes with official documentation, keeping your business fully compliant with
   Kenyan environmental law.
3. #### Converted at our bio-refinery
   
   Every drop is processed into distilled B100 biodiesel and useful by-products — nothing goes to
   waste or into the drains.
4. #### Collected by trucks running on your oil
   
   Our entire collection fleet runs on biodiesel made from the very oil it collects. The loop is
   real, and it's on the road.

[Book a Collection][15]
Why B100

## A better molecule for your engine — and the air

Biodiesel isn't just cleaner on paper. It's safer to store, kinder to engines, and dramatically
lighter on emissions than petroleum diesel.

# Notpla
# Disappearing
# Packaging

[Pause video][Play video]

# Convenience doesn't have
# to cost the world

This simple food container is carefully engineered to eliminate waste and make the planet a
healthier place. Where conventional containers have petrol-based coatings that stick around forever,
this one has a 100% natural seaweed coating. Once finished, the whole package can be composted and
disappears without a trace—just like a fruit peel.
[more about Notpla Food Containers][14]

# Seaweed forever

There are forests below the sea that are very dear to us. Seaweed grows quickly, and needs no
freshwater, land or fertiliser. It captures carbon and makes the surrounding waters less acidic.

Beyond this, seaweed is abundantly available and has near-magical material properties. In the quest
to heal our ecosystems and food chains from the toxic waste of plastic packaging, it is the perfect
companion species and an integral partner to our solutions.
[more about Notpla's Impact Theory][15]

# The liquid packaging revolution

This is where it all began for Notpla.

Taking inspiration from nature, this innovative solution offers a sustainable alternative to
single-use plastic packaging. Its unique design allows the liquid to be encapsulated in a thin,
flexible layer that is 100% naturally biodegradable and entirely edible.
[more about Ooho][16]

# **Reinventing the coffee cup without plastic**

As part of a €4 million, three year Horizon Europe research project, Notpla is working to reinvent
one of the world’s most overlooked single use products.

Building on early pilots, including our Gen 1 espresso cup, the project brings together partners
across Europe and Africa to develop a high performance coffee cup with a fully natural coating that
does not rely on plastic.
[more about the Horizon Grant][17]

# Microplastics in food packaging: the hidden problem

Microplastics are now being detected across food systems, from water and seafood to human tissue.As
research evolves, attention is turning to how everyday materials, including packaging, may
contribute to exposure.
[read more][18]

# Applications for a new everyday

Our collection includes true solutions for packaging foods, drinks, care products, and many other
items you use every day. While some are edible, some compostable, and some dissolve in water — they
all disappear back into nature without any harmful traces.

## Delivering on ***Our Word***

Walking the Walk For Over 50 Years

Founded in Atlanta, Georgia by Frank Pritchard in 1972 as a manufacturer of protective packaging
products, Pak-Lite, Inc. has embarked on a progressive path of product diversification and enhanced
capabilities. Guiding them to the position of a leading North American converter/manufacturer of
US-sourced foams, rubber, nonwovens, foils, films, and specialty materials. Our customer base
includes many of the top OEM and industrial companies in the world.

[Connect with Us][20]

## **Why choose** Pak-Lite, Inc? 
## Because We **Manufacture Success**

PLI has manufacturing facilities in GA, NC, and Taiwan. We have over 300+ dedicated professionals
committed to making your project a success before, during, and after the design and manufacturing of
your product. We will help you select the best, sustainable materials for your specific application.
Join our customer base, which already includes many of the top OEM and industrial companies in the
world.

[Why We're Different][21]

## Manufacturing Capabilities*

Our manufacturing capabilities include extrusion lamination to foams and rubber substrates. We
combine materials to composite form and then supply you with die-cut parts, components, roll stock,
or sheeting. Finished parts often include pressure-sensitive adhesives and release liners.
Additional capabilities include material selection, prototyping, skiving/slitting, rotary/flatbed
die cutting, kiss cutting, spooling, precision parts manufacturing, assembly, and much more.

[Lab][23]

## Material ***Fabrication***

We are ISO 9001:2015 and IATF 16949 certified with a wide selection of capabilities in converting
foams, rubbers, and nonwoven fabrics for the OEMs and Tier 1 automotive industry. PLI will assist
you in designing the exact components to meet your demanding specifications. We have extensive
experience with 3M Adhesives and Avery Adhesives as well as years of sourcing the top foam, rubber,
polymer, packaging, nonwoven, and fiber and film suppliers worldwide.

## Delivering on ***Our Word***

Walking the Walk For Over 50 Years

Founded in Atlanta, Georgia by Frank Pritchard in 1972 as a manufacturer of protective packaging
products, Pak-Lite, Inc. has embarked on a progressive path of product diversification and enhanced
capabilities. Guiding them to the position of a leading North American converter/manufacturer of
US-sourced foams, rubber, nonwovens, foils, films, and specialty materials. Our customer base
includes many of the top OEM and industrial companies in the world.

## **Why choose** Pak-Lite, Inc? 
## Because We **Manufacture Success**

PLI has manufacturing facilities in GA, NC, and Taiwan. We have over 300+ dedicated professionals
committed to making your project a success before, during, and after the design and manufacturing of
your product. We will help you select the best, sustainable materials for your specific application.
Join our customer base, which already includes many of the top OEM and industrial companies in the

## Manufacturing Capabilities*

Our manufacturing capabilities include extrusion lamination to foams and rubber substrates. We
combine materials to composite form and then supply you with die-cut parts, components, roll stock,
or sheeting. Finished parts often include pressure-sensitive adhesives and release liners.
Additional capabilities include material selection, prototyping, skiving/slitting, rotary/flatbed
die cutting, kiss cutting, spooling, precision parts manufacturing, assembly, and much more.

[Lab][23]

## Material ***Fabrication***

We are ISO 9001:2015 and IATF 16949 certified with a wide selection of capabilities in converting
foams, rubbers, and nonwoven fabrics for the OEMs and Tier 1 automotive industry. PLI will assist
you in designing the exact components to meet your demanding specifications. We have extensive
experience with 3M Adhesives and Avery Adhesives as well as years of sourcing the top foam, rubber,
polymer, packaging, nonwoven, and fiber and film suppliers worldwide.

## How can we help you?

How we can help you with Frequently Asked Questions.

##### What’s the Packaging design process?

At the Premier Custom Boxes, we collaborate with our clients. We treat them as partners and ensure
they receive a premier experience. Our design team crafts boxes that fulfill their business goals as
per their requirements. We carry out branding, customization, printing, and share templates with
them to get their feedback.

##### Do I need to pay any shipping costs for packaging boxes?

No. You won’t have to pay any delivery charges if you place an order in any state of the USA. Our
services cover the whole of the USA. We ship custom packaging boxes perfectly, so our clients pack
products and market them correctly.

##### Is there any minimum count of packaging boxes that I can order?

You can order a minimum of 100 packaging boxes from us. This facility also comes with the offset
printing option. Our team ensures smooth and frictionless delivery no matter the packaging
shipment’s size.

##### Can I order eco-friendly packaging boxes?

You can order environment-friendly packaging boxes from us. Businesses will have the facility to opt
for kraft cardstock because of its recyclable nature. These are bio-degradable and don’t harm our
natural habitat. We use sustainable raw materials in the production process that are pure and don’t
impact our surroundings.

##### What is your order processing time?

When you order packaging boxes or printing services, the team gets down to business. The turnaround
time is fast, and our team works tirelessly on the order’s processing. Within 10 to 12 working days,
we ship boxes to your doorstep. In some cases, businesses request instant delivery. So, we also have
a rapid delivery process through which we ship orders within a week.

##### Can I get a price quote for packaging boxes?

You can visit our website and go to the price quote section. You need to fill out a form and tell us
about your requirements. You need to select the packaging box type, cardstock, and quantity of boxes
required. There’s also a section where you will mention the box dimensions, and you can also give
special instructions. Our team will respond with a detailed price quote.

##### Do I have the option of Add-ons along with the packaging boxes?

There are numerous Add-on options, and you can get complete guidance from our packaging team. These
include custom inserts that come in various forms and colors. You can use them inside the packaging
to add grace and give extra cushion to items. Similarly, boxes with magnetic lids are available. You
can style them through finishing options like Spot UV, Glossy and Matte coating.

Sci-Bot - answering questions based on research

Hear the good news: recent advances in artificial intelligence enabled Sci-Hub to launch a
[robot][2] that gives scientifically-grounded responses to questions. The robot starts with
searching for relevant literature in Sci-Hub database, then turns to selecting and reading most
recent studies, and composes the answer based on this information. The answer includes all the
references, and each referenced article can be read on Sci-Hub with one click.

Unlike question-answering robots that were based upon the early generation of neural networks,
Sci-Hub bot does not hallucinate and is not making up scientific facts and does not cite sources
that do not exist. To support its statements, Sci-Bot uses articles from Sci-Hub database. Questions
can be asked in any language, and answers can be saved on server and shared.

The alpha version only supports answerig one question, and a more advanced variation that supports
conversation mode is coming soon. Right column displays example questions that has been answered by
robot - push the question to see the generated answer.

[What is the most precise value for Pi number calculated to date?][5]→

# Where do I get new articles?

Sci-Hub coverage is larger than 90% for all papers published up to 2022 in major academic outlets.
Newer articles can be requested on a new platform [Sci-Net][6] which is a mutual-help social network
for researchers: you can post a request and it will be solved by other members. The fulltext
typically gets uploaded in a few minutes, except for some exotic cases. Once uploaded, the paper
remains free for everyone without registration. You can also upload your papers to ensure they will
be openly accessible forever.

The project uses Sci-Hub knowledge tokens to reward active members for helping build its open access
repository.

# database

Sci-Hub has the largest (> 88 million documents) database of full-text scientific papers, available
for free. Approximately 80% of the collection are articles from scientific journals, most of them
dedicated to the subject of medicine. That is followed by physics, chemistry and biology,
humanities, and etc. The entire collection is available for download on the [torrent network][7],
and takes up about 100 terabytes of space.

Sci-Bot - answering questions based on research

Hear the good news: recent advances in artificial intelligence enabled Sci-Hub to launch a
[robot][2] that gives scientifically-grounded responses to questions. The robot starts with
searching for relevant literature in Sci-Hub database, then turns to selecting and reading most
recent studies, and composes the answer based on this information. The answer includes all the
references, and each referenced article can be read on Sci-Hub with one click.

Unlike question-answering robots that were based upon the early generation of neural networks,
Sci-Hub bot does not hallucinate and is not making up scientific facts and does not cite sources
that do not exist. To support its statements, Sci-Bot uses articles from Sci-Hub database. Questions
can be asked in any language, and answers can be saved on server and shared.

The alpha version only supports answerig one question, and a more advanced variation that supports
conversation mode is coming soon. Right column displays example questions that has been answered by
robot - push the question to see the generated answer.

[What is the current size of the Universe?][3]→
[To be or not to be?][4]→
[What is the most precise value for Pi number calculated to date?][5]→

# Where do I get new articles?

Sci-Hub coverage is larger than 90% for all papers published up to 2022 in major academic outlets.
Newer articles can be requested on a new platform [Sci-Net][6] which is a mutual-help social network
for researchers: you can post a request and it will be solved by other members. The fulltext
typically gets uploaded in a few minutes, except for some exotic cases. Once uploaded, the paper
remains free for everyone without registration. You can also upload your papers to ensure they will
be openly accessible forever.

The project uses Sci-Hub knowledge tokens to reward active members for helping build its open access
repository.

# database

Sci-Hub has the largest (> 88 million documents) database of full-text scientific papers, available
for free. Approximately 80% of the collection are articles from scientific journals, most of them
dedicated to the subject of medicine. That is followed by physics, chemistry and biology,
humanities, and etc. The entire collection is available for download on the [torrent network][7],
and takes up about 100 terabytes of space.

About Us
Nowadays in this fast moving world, people have less time to cook and enjoy the taste of home-cooked
food and hence in order to preserve the taste, freshness, aroma, nutrient value & warmth of food
items for longer duration of time, many types of wrapping and packing materials are used.
Incorporated in 1972, Sun Pack Corporation is a leading manufacturer, exporter, supplier, importer
and trader of an extensive range of Packing, Wrapping, Packaging and Laminated Materials such as
Printed Wax Wrappers, Plain & Printed Laminated Films in Rolls and Pouches etc. We cater to the
packing and wrapping needs of clients in domestic as well as major international markets. Our
product specialization includes Wax Coating, 8 Colour Roto Gravure Printing, Solvent Free
Lamination, etc.
